title: tour in Andalusia in the white villages
text: We collected our rental car after landing in Malaga. We have already visited the main cities of Andalusia on a previous trip: Granada, Cordoba, Seville. This time we decided to move away from the big cities. First stop Ronda: spectacular bridge between the old town and the new, the arena is a little disappointing, we have already visited more interesting ones. Lots of tourists, fortunately we booked a hotel outside the city in the middle of the olive trees.
